notes.title: CHALLENGE MODE IS HERE!
notes.content: [h1]Challenge Mode is here![/h1][p][/p][p]We welcome you to try the new challenge mode. You can find it in the Modifiers panel ([i]If you have beaten the normal level[/i]). [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45556998/8555a7cceb9c20329b654815f8250377816cd1f3.png"][/img][/p][p]There are many traps located around the map and you will find that the layout has changed quite drastically. Normally we want to test our players but even we struggled with the level so we added in some checkpoints so we don't go insane, Falling isn't the only danger to us now as dying has become the new norm. Extra brownie points if you beat the challenge level with all modifiers and easy mode turned off, [i]We haven't even attempted that.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]The Changes:[/p][list][*][p]New challenge level (accessible by the modifier panel in the main menu)[/p][/*][*][p]Traps and player death (along with checkpoints)[/p][/*][*][p]Moving platforms to make it more dynamic[/p][/*][*][p]fixes to the grapple (some visual bugs with the moving platforms still being worked on)[/p][/*][*][p]improved beginner friendliness (added a little tutorial at the start)[/p][/*][*][p]Some QOL features ( UI pop ups to explain modifiers etc.)[/p][/*][*][p] 1 New achievement (The one and only achievement you'll need)[/p][/*][*][p]various other small fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for the support. We will be looking to make more improvements and fix any bugs that we might've missed. [/p]

tags.bug: fixes to the grapple (some visual bugs with the moving platforms still being worked on)

tags.feature: improved beginner friendliness (added a little tutorial at the start)
Some QOL features ( UI pop ups to explain modifiers etc.)

notes.title: Challenge mode is coming!!!
notes.content: [h1][b]Challenge mode will be dropping on the 8th of august![/b][/h1][p][/p][p]This new mode introduces a variety of new challenges and mechanics that will keep you on your toes. We will get into more detail on release but just know that falling is no longer the only thing you have to worry about.[/p]
